==> quadlet/roostack-caddy.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack: reverse proxy (Caddy)

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-caddy
Image=roostack-caddy.build
Network=pasta:--map-host-loopback,169.254.1.3
PublishPort=80:80
PublishPort=443:443
PublishPort=443:443/udp
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/caddy:/etc/caddy:ro
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/caddy-data:/data
Secret=roostack-caddy-dns-api_token,type=env,target=DNS_API_TOKEN
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/caddy-logs:/var/log/caddy
Secret=roostack-crowdsec-bouncer-key,type=env,target=CROWDSEC_API_KEY
Label=io.roostack.service=_system
Label=io.roostack.component=caddy

[Service]
ExecReload=/usr/bin/podman exec roostack-caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> quadlet/roostack-caddy.build
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack: build the reverse proxy image (Caddy with DNS plugins)

[Build]
ImageTag=localhost/roostack-caddy:latest
File=/usr/share/roostack/caddy/Containerfile
SetWorkingDirectory=file

[Service]
TimeoutStartSec=1800
StandardOutput=truncate:/var/lib/roostack/caddy-build.log
StandardError=inherit

==> quadlet/roostack-crowdsec.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack: CrowdSec, which blocks attackers of public services

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-crowdsec
Image=docker.io/crowdsecurity/crowdsec:v1.8.1@sha256:0f2523fa61ef507f15d953045cface490cc880670c62f2755ced17524107f71a
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:8473:8080
Environment=COLLECTIONS=crowdsecurity/caddy
Secret=roostack-crowdsec-bouncer-key,type=env,target=BOUNCER_KEY_caddy
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/crowdsec/config:/etc/crowdsec
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/crowdsec/data:/var/lib/crowdsec/data
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/crowdsec/acquis.yaml:/etc/crowdsec/acquis.d/caddy.yaml:ro
Volume=/var/lib/roostack/caddy-logs:/var/log/caddy:ro
Label=io.roostack.service=_system
Label=io.roostack.component=crowdsec

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/Caddyfile
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.
{
	email admin@example.com
	crowdsec {
		api_url http://169.254.1.3:8473
		api_key {env.CROWDSEC_API_KEY}
		ticker_interval 15s
	}
}

*.lab.example.com {
	tls {
		dns cloudflare {env.DNS_API_TOKEN}
	}
	log {
		output file /var/log/caddy/access.log {
			roll_size 20MiB
			roll_keep 5
		}
		format json
	}
	@roostack-admin host roostack.lab.example.com
	handle @roostack-admin {
		route {
			crowdsec
			rate_limit {
				zone roostack-admin-login {
					match {
						path /login /login/* /backups/recovery-key /backups/recovery-key/*
					}
					key {remote_host}
					events 10
					window 1m
				}
				zone roostack-admin {
					key {remote_host}
					events 1000
					window 10s
				}
			}
			reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:8480
		}
	}

	import sites/*.caddy

	# Unknown subdomains get no response.
	handle {
		abort
	}
}

==> file /var/lib/roostack/crowdsec/acquis.yaml
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.
# CrowdSec reads Caddy's access log (SPEC.md §6.11).
filenames:
  - /var/log/caddy/*.log
labels:
  type: caddy
